description.value: No. 9 Restaurant is a 24-hour Chinese and Western restaurant located inside Lansdowne Shopping Centre in Richmond, BC. The menu spans Szechuan and chef specialties, family dinner sets, vegetarian options, Western breakfast, and tea-time specials, with a strong emphasis on sharing dishes. Its round-the-clock availability, including public holidays, makes it a rare all-hours stop for cyclists passing through Richmond.

address.value: Unit 812, 5300 Number 3 Road, Richmond, BC V6X 2X9
